diagnosis.what_happened: Table rendering in DOCX violated RTL layout, captions were split, headers used raw Persian instead of APA symbols, raw markdown was leaked, and redundant heading duplication occurred.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failure to apply OpenXML bidi properties and parse markdown properly resulted in strict 28 check validation failure.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Strict application of <w:bidiVisual/> for RTL tables, parsing of Markdown inside cells, deduplication of headings, single-line table captions, and APA Latin metrics in table headers.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Scholarly Persian APA 7 Word deliverables require exact typographic handling, native RTL table grids, and uniform structural layout to pass graduate office scrutiny.

desired_behavior: Always apply bidiVisual to tables, use single-line table captions, enforce APA 7 Latin abbreviations (M, SD, etc.) in table headers, parse and translate markdown formatting in Word cell elements, and prevent duplicate document headings.
generalization: All Word document generation routines must enforce bidi RTL structural elements and parse markdown into native Word formatting elements while adhering strictly to APA reporting symbols.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero failures allowed for global table/docx standards.
